name: Documentation analytics policy
description: First-party permission for optional documentation analytics

rules.description: Allow PR 142 analytics outside EU and unknown locations
rules.expression: http.host eq "libtmux.org" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pr-142/") and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_shell/web-analytics.json") and (ip.src.country ne "" and not ip.src.country in {"AT" "AX" "BE" "BG" "CY" "CZ" "DE" "DK" "EE" "ES" "FI" "FR" "GF" "GP" "GR" "HR" "HU" "IE" "IT" "LT" "LU" "LV" "MF" "MQ" "MT" "NL" "PL" "PT" "RE" "RO" "SE" "SI" "SK" "YT" "XX" "T1"})
